title: Kino Loy
description: Kino Loy was an inmate at the Narkina 5 prison. Cassian Andor met Loy inside while Andor was incarcerated. Loy wanted to finish his sentence, but the Public Order Resentencing Directive changed his mind. Loy and Andor triggered an uprising. Loy rallied prisoners to escape. However, the prisoners needed to swim to freedom, and Loy couldn't swim.
